text:
I made some updates to my Digital Eye project (check my previous video) and decided to do my version of Barad Dur and the eye of Sauron that was animated in my Ocoola app.
For this project I've used ESP32C3 super mini and GC9A01 display.
Project files, diagrams and my app are available for my patrons (good gravy and higher), printables members and on Cults.
